newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia comic aims to tell jokes for 60 hours.
newsitem.headline: Colombia comic aims to tell jokes for 60 hours.

text.p: A Colombian comic said on Tuesday that he plans to tell 60 non-stop hours of jokes later this month in a marathon performance on live radio in Ecuador.

Jose Ordonez, who staged a 50-hour joke fest on Colombia's Caracol radio network in October 1996, said his latest performance, set to begin on March 19, was aimed at raising money for a charity that supports Ecuadoran street children.
It will be broadcast live on Radio Alfa and Radio Galaxia in Guayaquil, Ecuador's leading city, Ordonez told Reuters.

Ordonez, 29, did not say whether any of his jokes would focus on Abdala Bucaram, the Ecuadoran president who was ousted for his high-stakes antics after just six months in office last month. But he is clearly hoping to provide better entertainment than the former president, a man who called himself "El Loco" (Madman) and who launched a singing career soon after he was sworn in as president.
